notes_for_editor: Index row and FWS About Us page read in full; ODU species list grepped for fire tower captions only. The ODU captions do not show the tower's location, builder or date, and it is not confirmed that the photographed tower is the listed one. The Suffolk News-Herald 2011 fire coverage returned 403 and is not cited. Not confirmed whether the tower lies inside the refuge, so access is unknown and the story gives no visit advice beyond asking staff. No events or facts added because no readable source supports them. Searches: 1. Page reads: 3, with the index shared with the other towers. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the ODU source title was 'A to Z Index' (search-result link text); the page heading is 'Great Dismal Swamp Species List' and its title tag is 'Great Dismal Swamp', so source 2 was corrected. Source 3 title was set to the FWS page title tag. Story wording that copied the FWS and quote phrasing was reworded.
